nodes.label: Turn Ingest — POST /session/message, SSE Open, Transcript Write
nodes.skip_or_fallback: Runtime down answers with an unavailable SSE frame instead of dropping the turn; the user message is recorded before any model call so the routing eval stays complete.

nodes.label: Fast Lanes & LLM Router — music/news/video gates, modifiers.kind
nodes.skip_or_fallback: Music fast lane plays a fallback within MUSIC_ROUTER_BUDGET_S (1.5 s) and refines in place within MUSIC_ROUTER_REFINE_S (25 s); video/live/news keep deterministic overrides.

nodes.label: Shared Runtime Turn — /agent via runtime adapter with attribution headers
nodes.skip_or_fallback: Shared-box saturation (Jetson/Gold Spark) degrades to the lane's deterministic answer instead of an empty canvas; probes must carry x-project/x-headers like /agent.

nodes.label: News Pipeline — corpus-first collect, verify, diversify, summarize
nodes.skip_or_fallback: A slow source loses only itself; the editor must not drop a gated story. Named live networks play their own stream, never a look-alike.

nodes.label: Research Coordinator — worker dispatch, evidence ledger, answer versions
nodes.skip_or_fallback: Budget module caps worker calls and wall time; a capped run returns the evidence it has. An answer that cannot cite evidence is returned partial with the missing evidence named.

nodes.label: Widget Factory — server-render with strict data-hn-config
nodes.skip_or_fallback: Types absent from the catalog cannot be requested; degenerate widget renders are coerced or dropped, and only utilities present in the compiled Tailwind build are emitted.

nodes.label: Canvas Commit — per-session lock, placement, note-row serialize
nodes.skip_or_fallback: A corrupt widget row is skipped and logged, never aborting the canvas; singleton media widgets are reused or replaced under the session lock.

nodes.label: Client Mount & Self-Heal — rebuild from data-hn-config only
nodes.skip_or_fallback: A widget with no data-hn-config is left as-is and reported — never rebuilt from guessed defaults; device-style widgets skip the resizer and derive height from width.

edges.label: selected path + modifiers for the /agent turn
news ask normalized (topic or live network)
research intent and budget when the ask needs current facts
parsed widget plan from the runtime answer
cited evidence for the synthesized answer
widget frame with data-hn-config over SSE
stored canvas HTML served to the client
widget actions posted back; server owns the canvas
